summary: Baosheng Media Group's four PRC subsidiaries agreed on September 14, 2026, to sell a portfolio of long-aged receivables and one prepaid account to Guangzhou Nengren Advertising Co., Ltd. for RMB8,561,500 (about US$1.26 million), the independent appraisal value; book balance was RMB226.2 million as of April 30, 2026. The buyer was the sole qualified bidder from a Beijing Equity Exchange listing. A 50% first installment and 50% within one month are required, ownership transferring on full payment, as-is, buyer bearing enforcement risk.
